featured.caption: After you sell juice at the market, a card points you to steady work.
Taking your car out of the garage: one card with your plate, and the hazard lights blink.
Every car you can buy now wears its license plate, front and back.
A house you bought gets a SOLD sign by its door.
The For sale sign: stand at it with the price in cash and choose Buy house.
The truck yard price list: both trucks say they need a truck license.
The truck check at the yard: pay $300, then drive the four gates.
A medic looking down at a downed player sees Revive first.
The clinic ward, with its hospital beds.
The gun counter list: a firearm permit comes first, then guns, magazines, scopes and holsters.
Shift-click on the map to set a waypoint; it shows the distance.
Once your arrival errands are done, the welcome guide sends you to your personal file for what to do next.
The bank vault with its round door swung open.
The bank vault door, closed.
The rebuilt market on the square, seen from above.
The juicer on a market table.
The farmer, dressed for the job, ready to talk.
The strongbox beside the cash van, with an evidence marker on the grass.
An ore rock at the quarry with a gold vein.
The spawn square: cobbles, the welcome sign and the payphone, with the village street beyond.
The general store with its sign, shop window and counter out front.
The fuel station on the main street: canopy, kiosk and till.
The village hospital with the ambulance parked in its bay.
The police post: duty desk, dispatch and wanted boards, and a jeep out front.
The car lot: four cars for sale, each with its price board.
The bank front with its two teller windows, one on each side of the door.
The farm: house, greenhouse and a worn cart track in the evening light.
The hospital front: name plate, Red Cross banner, dispatch board and duty desk.
The lawless quarry: the lane barrier, a warning sign and granite walls behind.
The supermarket on the square, seen from the cobbles.
A supermarket aisle: tomato crates and bottles on the shelves, posters on the wall.
Bread on the bakery rack, with the shop light on.
The clothing shop: boots and folded clothes on the tables, with customers inside.
The pub from the road, with its green sign over the door.
Inside the pub with the lights on: the bar, stools and the barman.
The garage yard: a workbench and a rack outside the red bay doors.
The fuel station kiosk at night, with the clerk and a customer at the counter.
An outpost camp in the pines by day: sandbags, a tent, a fire and the stock board.
The same outpost at night, lit by lanterns and the fire, with guards behind the sandbags.
An outpost guard at night. You can talk to him.
A rust-colored iron rock in the woods, ready to mine.
Coal rocks in a meadow, with a stack of planks nearby.
The smelter: the prompt reads two nuggets and one coal make a bar.
The coal buyer: a site container with the buyer at the counter and a scale beside it.
A patient lying on the grass near the hospital, with the ambulance on the road.
The bakery front at night, its sign lit by a street lamp.
The clinic front at night, with its sign and the notice board by the door.
A village street at night, with lamps lit along the cobbles.
The market at night, with the prices board and the stalls.
